title: The 5R Permissions: Five Things You May Do
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Five panels, one for each of the 5R permissions, each with the plain meaning, the test question to ask, and a classroom scene.

educational.topic: The 5R permissions: retain, reuse, revise, remix, redistribute
learningObjectives: The learner will identify which of the 5R permissions a classroom action uses, with at least 4 of 5 correct on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The meaning of an open license from [Chapter 1](../../chapters/01-foundations-of-oer/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: Can I make and keep my own copy?
Can I use it as it is?
Can I combine it with other open work?
Can I share copies with others?
commonMisconceptions: Reuse covers any use, including after changes
Retain means keeping a link to a resource online
Revise and remix are the same permission
Sharing an unchanged copy is reuse
assessmentOpportunities: You fix a typo in an open worksheet. Which permission is that?
You email an unchanged open worksheet to a colleague. Which permission?
Which permission lets you build one unit from chapters of two open textbooks?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Poster zones
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
